name: nginx-multisite
description: Deploys and secures Nginx for three configured subdomains, including static document roots, per-site virtual hosts, SSL certificates, Fail2ban, firewall rules, sysctl hardening, and SSH restrictions.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, and listener configuration on port 6379.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a tutorial FastAPI application with Python dependencies, a local PostgreSQL database, virtual environment, environment configuration, and a systemd service running Uvicorn.
